components.name: Primary Quote Button
components.description: Main quote action for hero, header, and service sections.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #3b0c0a; color: #ffffff; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px 28px; font: 800 12px/1 var(--font-inter, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #54110f; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e6aca4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Call Button
components.description: Phone action when quote is primary but direct call remains available.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #3b0c0a; border: 1px solid #6d1815; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px 28px; font: 800 12px/1 var(--font-inter, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #fbf3f1; border-color: #3b0c0a; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e6aca4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: WhatsApp Button
components.description: Messaging action reserved for WhatsApp journeys.
components.css: .ds-btn-whatsapp { background: #047857; color: #ffffff; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px 28px; font: 800 12px/1 var(--font-inter, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-whatsapp:hover { background: #065f46; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-whatsapp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #86efac; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Compact icon-led card for AC service categories.
components.css: .ds-service-card { min-height: 132px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; text-align: center; background: #ffffff; color: #030712; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 6px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: transform 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: #e6aca4; box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(59,12,10,0.1); } .ds-service-card h3 { margin: 0; font: 900 14px/1.25 var(--font-outfit, sans-serif); } .ds-service-icon { color: #54110f; font: 900 18px/1 var(--font-outfit, sans-serif); }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Booking modal field for service, location, and issue details.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #334155; font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-inter, sans-serif); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; background: #f8fafc; padding: 10px 12px; color: #030712; font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--font-inter, sans-serif); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #9d2925; outline: 2px solid rgba(157,41,37,0.24); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Sticky service navigation with compact links and high-priority quote action.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; background: #ffffff; color: #111827; font: 700 13px/1 var(--font-inter, sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a:focus-visible { color: #54110f; outline: none; }

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like a calm, capable service counter for a hot-climate emergency: direct, well-marked, and easy to act on. It is a brand surface, but the brand earns trust through operational clarity rather than decorative flourish. Every fold should answer the visitor's immediate question: can they help me, where, how quickly, and how do I contact them?

The system rejects cheap lead-generation contractor templates, overly flashy sales pages, generic stock-service layouts, and exaggerated emergency scare tactics. The existing direction is practical and trust-first: white service surfaces, deep oxblood authority, navy support tones, real HVAC imagery, compact cards, and persistent phone or WhatsApp paths.
keyCharacteristics: Direct CTA hierarchy for quote, phone, and WhatsApp actions.
Deep oxblood carries authority; white space carries clarity.
Real HVAC imagery supports credibility instead of acting as decoration.
Squared, practical controls feel professional and service-oriented.
Copy stays specific, reassuring, and action-ready.

rules.name: The Action Color Rule
rules.body: Oxblood means Al Maghseel authority; green means WhatsApp. Never blur those meanings.

rules.name: The Clean Surface Rule
rules.body: Most sections stay white or near-white. Trust comes from clarity, real images, and exact content, not from tinted decoration.

rules.name: The Plain Confidence Rule
rules.body: Type should be bold and readable, not stylized. Avoid editorial serif drama, decorative scripts, and tiny low-contrast labels.

rules.name: The Functional Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation must explain state or priority. If a shadow only decorates a static white box, remove it.

dos: Do preserve the quote, phone, and WhatsApp hierarchy on every major landing-page revision.
Do use real HVAC imagery when a section needs proof or atmosphere.
Do keep oxblood for Al Maghseel authority and WhatsApp green for WhatsApp only.
Do make service information scannable with clear headings, short explanations, and direct contact paths.
Do keep contrast strong enough for mobile use in bright environments.
donts: Don't create cheap lead-generation contractor templates.
Don't make the site overly flashy, alarmist, or dependent on emergency scare tactics.
Don't use generic stock-service layouts that hide practical contact information.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders, gradient text, glassmorphism, or repeated identical icon-card grids as decoration.
Don't over-round cards or controls beyond the existing practical radius unless the component is a modal.
